data.name: The Last Detour
data.detailed_description:
Auric Falcon, a lone traveler, and his drone companion, ADAM, are forced to make a detour to Earth in search of a vital energy source for their ship, all while on the run from the Citadella Militia.

The Last Detour is a short but memorable, single-player, story-driven journey through a desolate, post-apocalyptic Earth — specifically, a ruined farm and the secrets hidden beneath it. In this focused, approximately one-hour experience, you will navigate silent areas, examine crumbling structures, and investigate environmental clues to uncover the story. The gameplay emphasizes exploration and observation rather than combat, allowing players to piece together the narrative through their interactions with the environment.

Your goal is clear: Locate the energy source for your spaceship to continue your overarching journey, before the Militia finds you.

WHERE SILENCE SPEAKS - ENVIRONMENT AND SOUND

Unlike open-world or grind-heavy titles, The Last Detour offers a linear, cinematic adventure. There are no enemies or combat, platforming or rage-inducing challenges — instead, the emphasis is on exploration, atmosphere, and storytelling. Search the environment for clues, uncover hidden connections, and progress at your own pace.

The soundscape primarily consists of natural ambient sounds and environmental effects, with occasional background music enhancing key moments.

YOU ARE NEVER ALONE - ADAM

Throughout your journey, ADAM, your loyal drone, remains a constant companion. It lights dark areas, scans the environment for hidden details, and communicates through pre-written dialogue, providing both practical assistance and narrative depth.

GUIDED YET FREE - PERSPECTIVE CHOICE AND MISSION RISK

Switch freely between first- and third-person perspectives to suit your preferred playstyle as you guide Auric Falcon through the ruined landscapes, except during cinematic, pre-scripted sequences where the camera is locked to enhance the storytelling. Explore the environments at your own pace, uncover some optional Easter Eggs, and enjoy a fully self-contained journey in one sitting.

Time-limited sections occur occasionally, adding a subtle sense of urgency and creating moments where Auric Falcon’s mission can end in a deadly failure.

It is only a detour… but one that may define everything that comes after.

FEATURES :

  • No skill point system or character progression — Auric Falcon and ADAM are fully realized characters from the start, with defined personalities and abilities.

  • Linear journey through handcrafted environments – Travel across silent areas, ruined landscapes, and the remnants of humanity’s recent downfall while uncovering the story.

  • Drone companion – ADAM supports you throughout the journey, lights the way, scans the environment to reveal hidden details for you at any time, and communicates with you, enhancing immersion.

  • Cinematic atmosphere – Detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, occasional cutscenes, and minimalistic sound design create a film-like presentation of a ruined, post-war Earth.

  • First- and third-person gameplay – Switch freely between perspectives. Choose an immersive first-person view or a wider third-person camera as you guide the traveler.

  • Complete, standalone experience – Approximately one hour of single-player gameplay, no microtransactions, no filler content.

EXPERIENCE NEXT-GEN VISUALS POWERED BY Unreal Engine 5.

The environment takes full advantage of Nanite virtualized geometry, allowing highly detailed terrain and natural landscapes. From the rugged ground to the dynamic lighting, every scene is designed to create an immersive, cinematic atmosphere.

data.short_description: A lone traveler and his drone make a vital detour to a ruined Earth. Navigate haunting, cinematic landscapes and experience a tightly crafted, forward-driven adventure where every step brings you closer to what must be secured, in the hope that this will not be our last detour.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Hungarian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bit - Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super / Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game was developed and tested on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bit - Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game was developed and tested on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050.
